about: What a complete copy of Black & White looks like, file by file: where each file of the game folder comes from on the disc ('cab' is a file of the installer's data1.cab/data2.cab, with unshield's default names; 'disc' is a loose file of the disc), its size and SHA-256, the forms the file is known in from the other versions of the game ('variants'), and how it is checked ('strict', or 'any' for the files that carry a language). The five program files are under 'program': the app generates them at set-up and never takes them from the player's copy, so every version of the disc works. Paths, sizes and hashes only.
